correctness.rationale: For every n>=3 the support width is twice the sum of two largest absolute coordinates. The 2n(n-1) signed roots have minimal normalized center dot product 1/2 for distinct neighboring centers, hence caps are disjoint for w>=sqrt(6). Each root has 4(n-2) nearest neighbors, producing E=4n(n-1)(n-2) unordered first-contact pairs. At contact the other roots have strict smaller dot product, preventing simultaneous third intersections close to threshold. Tangent-coordinate lens inequality s|x|+c|y|^2/2<=epsilon gives precise power (sqrt6-w)^(n/2) and coefficient C_n=4sqrt3(n-1)(n-2)/pi*(2/3)^(n/4); the excess must enter the CDF with a positive sign. For n=3 a Voronoi-cell angular integral gives all stated piecewise CDF branches at 4/sqrt3 and sqrt6, including upper density 3/sqrt2. Independent 48-point cuboctahedral spherical-cell numerical quadrature matched formula to ~3.2e-10 absolute error; numerical checks supplement the analytic all-n argument. CDF is only fully given for n=3; n>3 claims upper exact interval and one-sided onset.
